text:
Assistant B is better. It is more detailed and more accurate.

Assistant A has some inaccuracies. It recommends a handshake together with a bow and a "firm handshake", which is not standard in Japan. It also advises avoiding direct eye contact, which is oversimplified. Its business card guidance is thin: it leaves out the two-handed presentation and the rule against writing on a card.

Assistant B gives specifics. These include two-handed card exchange, bow angles, the "-san" honorific, gift wrapping and not opening gifts immediately, dress code, consensus decision-making (ringi), and silence in conversation. It covers more topics and is accurate. One small point is questionable: the advice to avoid business talk at social events is generally reasonable, though it varies in practice.

Overall, B is more helpful and more accurate.
